title: App secrets
introDev: Values you save here go straight to this app's dev instance. The agent sees the names, never the values.
introProd: Values you save here go straight to this app's live instance. The agent sees the names, never the values.
savedRestart: {name} changed. Restart the app to use it.
removeBody: The stored value of {name} is deleted and cannot be recovered. The app loses it at its next restart.

nameProblem.format: Use capital letters, digits and _ and start with a letter, e.g. MY_API_KEY.
nameProblem.reserved: That name is reserved for the app runtime. Pick another one.

valueProblem.too_large: The value is too large (8 KB at most).
valueProblem.nul: The value contains a character that cannot be stored.

info: Keys this app needs, such as API tokens. Values are never shown again after saving, not even to you or the agent. Only the app's owner or an admin can change them.
